summary.text: Jacqualyn Meadow is the Democratic candidate for South Carolina House of Representatives District 56, facing Republican incumbent Tim McGinnis in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a lifelong educator, sports coach, leadership consultant and community advocate.

paragraphs.text: Jacqualyn Meadow earned a high school diploma from Newtown High School, a bachelor's degree from the State University of New York, Oneonta in 1987, and a graduate degree from City University of New York, Lehman College in 1996.
Her career experience includes working as an educator and business owner.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Meadow said she is known as "Coach Meadow" and that her parents moved to the Grand Strand 30 years ago.

Meadow said in the survey that she is running to focus on strengthening public education, supporting small businesses, investing in infrastructure, protecting taxpayers and improving flood mitigation in Horry County.

The priorities she listed were responsible growth and smart development, flood protection and stormwater management, protecting neighborhoods and property values, safe communities, and preserving quality of life.
